target_customer: People and culture teams at companies with roughly 30 to 150 employees
problem: Small and mid sized companies lack simple tools to measure employee wellbeing, engagement and stress and to act on the results.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with free plan and paid tiers

founders.name: Christian Højbo Møller
founders.background_notes: SEO Lead at GroupM Nordics, management consulting, built a fashion webshop as a teenager.

founders.name: Mikkel Agesen
founders.background_notes: No background listed on YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Survey and analytics SaaS with HRIS integrations is standard engineering; the AI insights layer came later.

defensibility.rationale: Pulse survey tools were abundant and easy to copy; benchmarks and integrations give only modest switching costs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded survey vendors already covered the wedge; Zoios shows no reported acquisition.

market_need_then: Remote work in 2021 raised employer interest in wellbeing and engagement measurement; no spend figures found for the Nordic SMB segment.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain B2B tone with promises of faster response and measured uplift

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand itself; name meaning not documented.

pivots.from: People, culture and performance platform with human expertise
pivots.to: Employee listening platform and leadership copilot

outcome_analysis: Zoios raised a small seed of about 1 million euros in mid 2024 and its website still presents a live employee listening product, even though YC lists it as Inactive. No shutdown or acquisition report was found, so the cause of any inactivity is not public and the record carries no failure code. It competed against well funded survey vendors in a crowded segment.
notes: YC status Inactive conflicts with a live marketing site and an exit of unknown. An August 2021 pre-seed of about $125k to $130k appears only on aggregators (Seedtable), so unverified and not recorded. Aggregator totals range $1.2M to $2.6M. The site names Langsom.com ApS in Aalborg as operator. Competitor sources are current vendor guides; only Peakon's 2021 Workday acquisition is dated to the period, other 2021 competitors not dated.
